title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: keep sensitive windows out of Windows Recall snapshots on Copilot+ PCs (Worldwide)
summary: The briefing needs a narrow correction: its statement that the feature takes no action beyond excluding content conflicts with Microsoft's documented audit logging and with its own description of Audit only. The administration paths, licensing and roadmap details are supported, but the claim that incomplete configuration fails silently is not documented.
